title: H3522 (125th General Assembly): Concealed weapons permits

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2022-12-15; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess125_2023-2024/prever/3522_20221215.htm (LegiScan doc 2618804))
provenance.note: Introduced text of 2022-12-15; no passage vote. Struck: 'or college' from item (5), so college athletic events leave the list of places a permit does not cover; the words 'of any kind' after 'firearm' and the old college/university wording in the school-property carve-out are struck.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Section 16-23-420(A)): The provisions contained in this subsection related to any premises or property owned, operated, or controlled by a college, university, technical college, or other post-secondary institution do not apply to a person who is authorized to carry a concealed weapon pursuant to Article 4, Chapter 31, Title 23.
Section 2 (Section 23-31-215(M)): A permit issued pursuant to this section does not authorize a permit holder to carry a concealable weapon into a: ... (5) school athletic event not related to firearms;
